image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a lionfish swimming near a coral reef. The fish displays characteristic reddish-brown and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays, and a prominent dorsal fin with long, separated spines. The background is a solid, vibrant blue, likely an aquarium tank, with textured coral and rock formations in the foreground.
